meta.title: Maeum Itgi — letters between generations
meta.description: One question a day brings parents and children closer, gathered into a book.

hero.title: One question a day turns your parent's stories into a book.
hero.subtitle: When your parent answers the questions you send, those stories come together as a single book.

1.title: Send a question
1.desc: Send today's question — or let your parent share a thought with you first.

2.title: Answer with ease
2.desc: Your parent can reply however feels easiest: in writing, photos, video, or voice.

3.title: It becomes a book
3.desc: Every story you share is gathered, page by page, into one book.

1.title: One easy question a day
1.desc: Just one question a day, starting with the easy ones, at a gentle pace.

2.title: Your parent's voice, as it is
2.desc: We keep their words just the way they say them — genuine and unpolished.

3.title: A book you can hold any time
3.desc: Once enough stories gather, you can receive them as a book whenever you like.

channel.heading: 📱 For now, answer in the app or on the web
channel.body: Parents can answer right in the app or on the web. Large text and simple buttons keep it easy.
channel.comingSoon: 🔜 Coming soon: reply via KakaoTalk / SMS.
